_meta.purpose: Operator brand color tokens for the Columbus micromobility market
_meta.method: Sampled directly from each operator's live public website — computed CTA button background colors and/or logo pixel sampling via headless browser inspection, not approximated from memory.
_meta.note: Third-party trademarks, referenced here only to visually identify each operator's own public vehicle/data records in a neutral, informational context — not an endorsement or claim of affiliation.

spin.sampled_from: dominant vivid accent color across site (used in text/borders/highlights)

veo.sampled_from: favicon (cropped-veo-favicon-1-270x270.png) and VeoPlus logo, consistent across both

bird.sampled_from: "Download the App" CTA button background (computed style), paired with #002139 as on-button text color

lime.sampled_from: "Download App" CTA button background (computed style), paired with black on-button text

unknown.note: Fallback for records where the source data does not identify an operator.
